newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Morris, N.J.

text.p: SUMMARY OF NOTICE OF SALE
Township of Morris
(in the County of Morris)
New Jersey
General Obligation Bond Sale
Consisting of
$9,511,000 General Improvement Bonds and
$3,585,000 Sewer Utility Bonds,
$155,000 Pool Utility Bonds and
$96,000 Parking Utility Bonds
Callable, Book-Entry Bonds, (Not Bank Qualified)
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial Officer of the Township of Morris, in the County of Morris, New Jersey (the
at the offices of the
Township's Bond Counsel, Lowenstein, Sandler, Kohl, Fisher & Boylan, 65 Livingston Avenue, Roseland, New Jersey 07068 on
Tuesday, April 29, 1997,
until 11:00 a.m., for the purchase of the above Bonds of the
Township dated May 1, 1997 and due (subject to redemption)
on May 1 as follows:
$9,511,000 General Improvement Bonds maturing in the
principal amount of $440,000 in the year 1998,
$490,000 in the year 1999, $540,000 in the year 2000,
$590,000 in the year 2001, $640,000 in the year 2002,
$690,000 in the year 2003, $880,000 in each of the
years 2004 to 2009, inclusive, and $841,000 in the
year 2010;
$3,585,000 Sewer Utility Bonds maturing in the
principal amount of $120,000 in the year 1998,
$125,000 in the year 1999, $130,000 in the year 2000,
$135,000 in the year 2001, $140,000 in the year 2002,
$145,000 in the year 2003, $150,000 in the year 2004,
$155,000 in the year 2005, $160,000 in each of the
years 2006 to 2008, inclusive, $165,000 in the year
2009 and $230,000 in each of the years 2010 to 2017,
inclusive;
$155,000 Pool Utility Bonds maturing in the principal
amount of $10,000 in each of the years 1998 to 2005,
inclusive, $15,000 in the year 2006 and $20,000 in
each of the years 2007 to 2009, inclusive; and
$96,000 Parking Utility Bonds maturing in the
principal amount of $10,000 in each of the years 1998
to 2006, inclusive and $6,000 in the year 2007.
The combined maturity schedule for the Bonds is as follows:
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate amount of each series of Bonds maturing in each year. The Township will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Lowenstein, Sandler, Kohl, Fisher & Boylan. The Bonds will bear interest at a rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on November 1, 1997, and

semiannually thereafter on May 1 and November 1 in each year until maturity. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the Notice of Sale. The Bonds are subject to redemption at the option of the Township in accordance with the Notice of Sale. The Bonds are subject to the requirements of SEC Rule 15c- 12 with respect to Secondary Market Disclosure. The Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting the Chief Financial Officer at the Township of Morris, 50 Woodland Avenue, Convent Station, New Jersey 07961 (201) 326-7381.
/s/ Julia A. Hasbrouck
Chief Financial Officer
(From The Bond Buyer)
